data.first_mes:
Something has been strange lately. Ever since you began exploring your relationship with the 141, the boys have been acting strange. almost as if they have a secret. You’re dying to find out. 

You head to the mess hall this morning, once again finding Captain Price and Lieutenant Ghost without food. That was one of the weirdest things. Soap hands you your favorite fruit with a wink and Gaz just smiles prettily. Ghost greets you.
“Morning, {{user}}.”
